Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?
Two of our most popular choices for daily riding are the Polygon Path 3 Urban City Bike ($699.99) and the Polygon Heist 2 Hybrid Bike ($899.99).
• Polygon Path 3: A sleek city bike with a rigid fork, lightweight alloy frame, and smooth 1x9 drivetrain. It's built for fast, efficient urban commutes on paved roads and paths.
• Polygon Heist 2: A versatile hybrid bike equipped with a SR Suntour front suspension fork. It gives you extra comfort and traction if your daily routes include rougher roads, gravel paths, or light trails.
If you ride mostly on smooth city streets and paved bike paths, the Polygon Path 3 is the best value and choice. If you want added comfort for mixed terrain and bumpy paths, the Polygon Heist 2 is ideal.
